01

Glyph Overview

Power socket system

Glyphs are a power customization system connected to character builds. The latest patch-note source confirms that Glyphs are supported as custom attributes on the market and that the Talent Tree can unlock an additional Glyph slot.

SLOT

Extra Slot

A generic Talent Tree notable can unlock +1 Glyph Slot.

+1 Glyph Slot
MKT

Market Support

Custom attribute support on the market includes Glyphs initially.

Glyph Tokens

Additional Patch Notes

Older confirmed references

Older patch notes reference specific glyph behavior and token rewards. These are included as source references only when they name the system directly. The current page avoids listing unsupported full glyph tables because the available archive does not include a complete current glyph catalog.
